children: ICICI Securities research report on Knowledge Realty Trust

KRT owns and manages a high-quality office portfolio in India. As one of India’s largest REITs — with a total leasable area of 46.5msf as of Jun’26 — it offers a healthy mix of scale, strong tenant quality and improving operating metrics. We estimate KRT to deliver a 9% NOI CAGR over FY26-29E, driven by likely narrowing of the gap between economic and committed occupancy, a portfolio MTM of 25%, and a robust under-construction pipeline with potential upsides from ROFO assets. At CMP, KRT offers FY27/28/29E distribution yield of 6.2/6.8/7.3%, representing an 8.7% DPU CAGR over FY26-29E.
We initiate coverage on Knowledge Realty Trust (KRT) with a BUY rating and a TP of INR 130, valuing the company at 1x FY27E NAV of INR 130/unit.
